key_decisions: B1 GO stated by Fabio after viewing 200% stills and a side-by-side, not self-certified - the plan's verify mode is user-ux and forbids self-certifying the gate.

Phase 3 re-scoped, not void: multiple LTX ID LoRAs exist. The shipped ltx23-lora-talkvid is LTXVReferenceAudio SPEAKER identity (wrong sense). The face one is Alissonerdx/LTX-Best-Face-ID, same LTX-2.3 22B checkpoint we ship. Do NOT re-reject it on its 'strictly reference-to-video' line the way H3 was rejected - unlike H3 we have a v2v path on that checkpoint, so whether its reference conditioning survives a denoise~0.3 init is a bench question.

MpiFaceWindow must be specced WITH tracking. B7 measured the static union window over 142 clips holding a tracked face: 62% blow the window past half the frame height, and single-face-only clips still fail 55%. The brief's 'defer the smoothed window until a real clip breaks it' is answered - most real clips break it.

SeedVR2 core already ships two pieces the brief planned to build: SeedVR2TemporalMerge does the chunk crossfade (brief step 6 is a wire, not work), and SeedVR2PostProcessing's 'wavelet' option IS the section 3 detail transfer (content_high_freq + style_low_freq, 5 levels). MpiDetailTransfer may be redundant - decided at B6, not before.
constraints: The bench was left RUNNING on 8188 (~40 GB resident) so B2 could start immediately. Kill it if B2 is not the next thing. Bench path is G:\ComfyUi\ComfyUI\ (nested); core is 0.31.0, ahead of the 0.30.2 the plan recorded.

SeedVR2TemporalChunk's chunking_mode is a DynamicCombo: in API format it flattens to sibling inputs ('chunking_mode': 'auto', or 'manual' plus 'frames_per_chunk'), NOT a nested dict. A nested dict passes validation and then dies at runtime with 'missing 1 required positional argument'.
ImageResizeKJv2 lanczos raises 'Lanczos is not supported on the GPU' - set device 'cpu' on that node.

B1's clip is a CLEAN 2560x1408 LTX generation. The product case Fabio named is a 'shitty face video'. The GO does not cover degraded footage; the held-back stress clip is cowboys/Media/ref2v_ms_006.mp4 (864x480, ~29px face, 8x upscale).
Raw vs wavelet being indistinguishable is NOT B6 answered - B1 skipped paste-back entirely by design.
